baseline_setting: Distribution of votes, seats and majorities at the election on 2026-10-25
what_it_means: Every output is conditional on the inputs below. It is a scenario-conditional forecast, not a prediction of fact.

baseline_setting: 250 seats, one national unit; threshold 3% of voters_turned_out; minority quotient x1.35 (all_minority); ties: larger_total_votes
what_it_means: Applied to every simulated draw. The other readings of the threshold base and of the uplift scope are computed from the same draws and reported as sensitivity.

baseline_setting: 5 polls from 3 pollsters (CRTA with Democracy Action Lab (Stanford); Faktor plus; NSPM (Nova srpska politicka misao)); last poll dated 2026-09-20; 35 days before the election
what_it_means: Shares are treated as shares of decided voters (decided_voters). Prediction markets are never an input.

baseline_setting: log-ratio of each polled list to "Aleksandar Vučić – Ujedinjena Srbija"; random walk 0.004 per day; pollster (house) effects with SD floor 0.15 (estimated 0.242); design effect 2; election-day miss SD 0.1
what_it_means: The pollster differences, not sampling error, are the largest source of uncertainty in the aggregate.

baseline_setting: ACTIVE: 9 qualifying event(s) dated after the last poll. Components: sps_none (weight 0.33: 0% of "Ivica Dačić – Faktor stabilnosti" to "Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju"); sps_moderate (weight 0.33: 10% of "Ivica Dačić – Faktor stabilnosti" to "Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju"); sps_strong (weight 0.33: 25% of "Ivica Dačić – Faktor stabilnosti" to "Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju")
what_it_means: Adds movement of voters that the polls cannot yet reflect. Departures from a party are not voter switching; the weights are analyst choices.

baseline_setting: participating voters drawn uniformly between 4,300,000 and 4,400,000
what_it_means: Your assumption, not an estimate. It sets municipal turnout, threshold denominators and minority vote counts; polls are shares among those who vote, so it barely moves list shares.

baseline_setting: valid votes = minority lists (bottom-up from their groups) + other non-minority lists (median share 0.02) + polled lists x the remaining pool
what_it_means: Keeps the list votes consistent with the valid votes of each draw.

baseline_setting: 400 unit draws from the national draws; local-election carry-over alpha in [0.0, 0.5, 1.0] (alpha = 0 is the headline map)
what_it_means: Distributes the national draws over the units; municipal turnout is calibrated to each draw. Local-election results never replace parliamentary shares.

baseline_setting: 20,000 national draws, seed 20261014; the same random numbers are used in every scenario
what_it_means: Because scenarios share random numbers, differences between scenarios are not Monte Carlo noise.

baseline_setting: median share "Aleksandar Vučić – Ujedinjena Srbija" 41.5%, "Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju" 41.3%; P(most seats) 51.7% and 50.3%
what_it_means: Read together with the intervals in A_national_votes_shares_seats.csv.
